summary.en: Alibaba's AI models with strong multimodal capabilities and Alibaba Cloud integration.
summary.zh: 阿里的 AI 模型，具备强大的多模态能力和阿里云集成。

title.en: Alibaba Qwen API Key - Multimodal AI on Alibaba Cloud | Get Model Key
title.zh: 阿里通义 API Key - 阿里云上的多模态 AI | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Alibaba Qwen API key for multimodal AI models. Access Qwen series on Alibaba Cloud.
description.zh: 获取阿里通义 API Key，访问多模态 AI 模型。在阿里云上使用通义系列模型。

benefit.en: Many models provide around 1M tokens of trial quota, commonly with a 90-day window (subject to official policy).
benefit.zh: 多数模型提供约 100 万 Token 体验额度，常见有效期约 90 天（以官方规则为准）。

notes.en: A broad model ecosystem, including popular options like Qwen and DeepSeek, which makes it useful as a versatile fallback pool for OpenClaw.
notes.zh: 模型池覆盖面广（含 Qwen、DeepSeek 等热门模型），适合作为 OpenClaw 的通用备用与兜底选项。

en: Alibaba’s Qwen (Tongyi) models run on DashScope, covering text, vision, audio, and coding variants with tight Alibaba Cloud integration.
Choose DashScope when you need Chinese-first multimodal models or want Qwen inside the same cloud account as other Alibaba services.
DashScope is Alibaba Cloud’s official model gateway, not a third-party aggregator. Get Model Key only links to the DashScope console; we do not sell keys.
zh: 阿里通义千问（Qwen）通过百炼/DashScope 提供服务，覆盖文本、视觉、音频与代码等能力，并与阿里云深度集成。
若需要中文优先的多模态模型，或希望与其他阿里云产品共用同一账号体系，可选择 DashScope。
DashScope 是阿里云官方模型网关，不是第三方聚合站。Get Model Key 仅跳转官方控制台，不售卖 API Key。

en: Sign in to Alibaba Cloud and open the DashScope console.
Go to https://dashscope.console.aliyun.com/apiKey and create an API key.
Copy the key once shown and store it outside shared chat logs.
Enable needed Qwen models and call DashScope APIs with the key per Alibaba docs.
zh: 登录阿里云并进入 DashScope（百炼）控制台。
打开 https://dashscope.console.aliyun.com/apiKey 创建 API Key。
密钥展示后立即复制，勿粘贴到公开聊天或代码仓库。
按需开通通义模型，并依阿里云文档用该 Key 调用 DashScope 接口。

question.en: Is DashScope the right place for Qwen API keys?
question.zh: 通义 API Key 是否在 DashScope 申请？

answer.en: Yes. Qwen API access is managed in the DashScope console under apiKey, not on a third-party marketplace.
answer.zh: 是。通义 API 访问权限在 DashScope 控制台的 apiKey 页管理，不在第三方市场购买。

question.en: What model families does Alibaba expose here?
question.zh: 这里能用到哪些通义模型？

answer.en: The directory lists Qwen text, coder, vision, and audio lines. Availability and quotas depend on your DashScope account.
answer.zh: 目录收录通义文本、代码、视觉、音频等系列；实际可调用型号与额度以你的 DashScope 账号为准。

question.en: Does this site sell Alibaba Cloud credits?
question.zh: 本站会售卖阿里云额度吗？

answer.en: No. Get Model Key only links to dashscope.console.aliyun.com. Purchase and billing stay on Alibaba Cloud.
answer.zh: 不会。Get Model Key 只链接 dashscope.console.aliyun.com，充值与计费均在阿里云完成。
